title: あいさつ・誘い・相づち・自宅訪問

items.en: Hey, how's it going?
How have you been?
Long time no see.
What have you been up to?
What are you up to this weekend?
Any plans for the holidays?
Did you do anything fun last weekend?
items.jp: 先週末は何か楽しいことした？

items.en: Where are you from originally?
How long have you been living here?
items.jp: ここにはどのくらい住んでるの？

items.en: What do you like about living here?
items.jp: ここの好きなところは？

items.en: It's pretty hot today, isn't it?
items.jp: 今日はけっこう暑いですね。

items.en: It looks like it's going to rain.
The weather's been great lately.
items.jp: 最近いい天気が続きますね。

items.en: I'm freezing. Can we go inside?
items.jp: 凍えそう。中に入らない？

items.en: Did you catch the game last night?
Have you seen any good movies lately?
What kind of music do you listen to?
I'm a big fan of baseball.
items.jp: 野球の大ファンなんだ。

items.en: I'm really into hiking these days.
items.jp: 最近ハイキングにはまってるんだ。

items.en: That sounds like fun. I'd love to try it.
items.jp: 楽しそう。やってみたいな。

items.en: Seriously? That's amazing.
No way! I can't believe it.
Tell me more about it.
What do you mean by that?
items.jp: それってどういう意味？

items.en: I know what you mean.
items.jp: 言いたいこと分かるよ。

items.en: That makes sense.
I couldn't agree more.
I'm not sure about that.
To be honest, I'm a little tired today.
items.jp: 正直、今日は少し疲れてるんだ。

items.en: Sorry, I zoned out for a second. What did you say?
items.jp: ごめん、一瞬ぼーっとしてた。何て言った？

items.en: Hold on, let me get this straight.
items.jp: ちょっと待って、整理させて。

items.en: It's no big deal.
Don't worry about it.
Thanks a lot. I owe you one.
items.jp: ありがとう。借りができたね。

items.en: Sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible.
items.jp: 遅れてごめん。渋滞がひどくて。

items.en: No worries. I just got here too.
items.jp: 大丈夫。私も今来たところ。

items.en: Let's grab lunch sometime.
items.jp: そのうちランチでも行こう。

items.en: Are you free tonight?
Want to come over for dinner on Saturday?
I'll bring dessert.
items.jp: デザートを持っていくよ。

items.en: Make yourself at home.
items.jp: どうぞくつろいでください。

items.en: Can I get you something to drink?
Help yourself to anything in the fridge.
items.jp: 冷蔵庫のものは自由にどうぞ。

items.en: Would you like seconds?
It was delicious. Thank you for having me.
items.jp: 美味しかったです。お招きありがとう。

items.en: I should get going. It's getting late.
items.jp: そろそろ帰らなきゃ。遅くなってきた。

items.en: Text me when you get home.
items.jp: 家に着いたらメールして。

items.en: Take care. See you soon.
Catch you later.
